summary.text: An infant son of Thyestes named after his infamous great-grandfather. According to Hyginus, he was murdered and served to his father at the horrific banquet of Atreus.

story.text: Atreus took vengeance on Thyestes by butchering his infant sons, Tantalus and Plisthenes. He roasted their flesh and fed it to Thyestes at a feast of supposed reconciliation.
